description: Native Config Model - Organized by Category (Phase 1 + Phase 2 + Phase 3 Completion)
approach: Comprehensive coverage of all native augment modules plus per-interface-type and policy endpoints. Phase 1 (14 core files, 183 endpoints) + Phase 2 (8 expansion files, 70 modules) + Phase 3 (5 new files: policy + 4 interface groups, 7 gap endpoints added to existing files)
phase3_new_files: native-policy.json (5 endpoints: service-group, class-map, policy-map, parameter-map/type, control-plane/service-policy)
native-intf-virtual.json (18 endpoints: Loopback, Tunnel, Vlan, nve, LISP, pseudowire, etc.)
native-intf-wan.json (17 endpoints: Serial, ATM, CEM, Dialer, Cellular, Port-channel, etc.)
native-intf-service.json (15 endpoints: AppNav, Service-Engine, ucse, LORAWAN, WPAN, etc.)
phase2_new_files: native-app-services.json (7 endpoints: kron, app-hosting, nbar, service-discovery, service-routing, mdns-gateway, pnp)
native-l2-discovery.json (5 endpoints: lldp, arp, icmp, loop-detect, uplink-autoconfig)
native-routing-multicast.json (7 endpoints: ospfv3, rsvp, nhrp, mobileip, igmp, multicast, mld)
native-security-services.json (5 endpoints: umbrella, fqdn, group-policy, pae, sanet)
native-platform-diag.json (13 endpoints: alarm-profile, diagnostics, buffers, dying-gasp, geo, gnss, synce, qfp-stats, ida, rmi-dad, ethinternal-subslot, ucse, mmode)
native-wan-legacy.json (12 endpoints: adsl, atm, bba-group, dialer, isdn, pppoe, vpdn, isg, ipc, ipmux, l2nat, l3nat-iox)
native-industrial-iot.json (11 endpoints: cellular, coap, dapr, digitalio, dlr, irig, lorawan, lte450, mrp, prp, rawsocket)
native-misc-ext.json (10 endpoints: wccp, vstack, vservice, ezpm, iwanfabric, pathmgr, perf-measure, site-manager, voice-port, interfaces)
